# Compatibility

27 recipes. A *family* recipe covers a whole class of game rather than one title,
so the real number of playable games is in the hundreds.

Status is a promise to the next person, and contributors are asked not to inflate it:

| Status | Means |
|---|---|
| `supported` | built, run on a real iPhone, and played |
| `partial` | runs, with caveats recorded in the recipe |
| `experimental` | boots; may be unplayable |
| `planned` | recipe written, runtime not ported yet |
| `blocked` | can't proceed — see the recipe's notes |


> **Everything is `planned` right now.** The build pipeline does not exist yet, so by the
> definition above nothing can honestly claim more. Per-runtime iOS readiness is tracked
> separately in [`runtimes/registry.toml`](../runtimes/registry.toml) as the `ios` field,
> and `porthole plan <game>` reports it.

## Tier 2 — emulated consoles

A libretro core emulating the original hardware. Excellent for 8- and 16-bit; the later systems depend on JIT availability.

| Game | Year | Runtime | Status | Controls |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Console ROMs and disc images** *(family)* | — | libretro (core host) | `planned` | `gamepad` |

## Tier 3 — interpreted runtimes

The game was always data fed to an interpreter, and Porthole ships the interpreter. Reliable and frequently flawless.

| Game | Year | Runtime | Status | Controls |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **DOS games (generic)** *(family)* | — | DOSBox Staging | `planned` | `keyboard-overlay` |
| **Godot games (generic)** *(family)* | — | Godot export template | `planned` | `passthrough` |
| **LÖVE games (generic)** *(family)* | — | LÖVE | `planned` | `passthrough` |
| **ScummVM-supported adventure games** *(family)* | — | ScummVM | `planned` | `pointer-direct` |

## Missing a game?

A recipe is about thirty lines of TOML and needs no Mac, no Xcode, and no Apple developer
account — just a copy of the game and twenty minutes. See [RECIPES.md](RECIPES.md).

Games whose engines have no open-source reimplementation and never ran on a console are
Tier 4 territory, which is honestly not a good place. See [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md#non-goals).
